name: Marchelle Paholsky

bio.statement: Paholsky's pamphlet statement lists work as director of strategy at the U.S. Department of Energy and grassroots organizing.
bio.excerpt: US Department of Energy - Director of Strategy; grassroots organizing in public and non-profit

bio.statement: Paholsky's pamphlet statement lists service as a U.S. Army master sergeant and Happy Valley planning commissioner.
bio.excerpt: United States Army Master Sergeant, Happy Valley Planning Commissioner,

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Paholsky says Happy Valley needs strong leadership to manage change in Oregon's fastest-growing city.
positions.excerpt: Happy Valley needs strong leadership to manage the inevitable changes in Oregon’s fastest growing city.

positions.statement: Paholsky's pamphlet statement says she would improve transportation corridors to reduce congestion, enhance safety and move commercial traffic to safer zones.
positions.excerpt: Improve our transportation corridors to reduce congestion, enhance safety, and move commercial traffic to safer zones.

positions.statement: Paholsky's pamphlet statement says she would preserve natural resources and expand scenic trails connecting neighborhoods.
positions.excerpt: Preserve our natural resources and expand scenic trails that connect our neighborhoods to promote outdoor activities.

positions.statement: Paholsky's campaign site says residents deserve transparent, accountable leadership that listens first and plans wisely.
positions.excerpt: I believe residents deserve transparent, accountable leadership that listens first and plans wisely.
